title: United Stables launches U
description: United Stables announced U on Ethereum and BNB Chain as a reserve-backed U.S.-dollar stablecoin.
notes: Launch date follows the dated public announcement.

title: OSL and Anchorage launch USDGO
description: USDGO launched on Solana as an enterprise stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank and distributed under the OSL brand.
notes: Issuer and distributor roles remain separate.

title: SoFi launches SoFiUSD infrastructure
description: SoFi announced its fully reserved payment stablecoin for banks, fintechs, and enterprise partners.
notes: Later network and consumer-platform availability are separate distribution or deployment boundaries.

title: Solstice Finance launches USX
description: Solstice Finance launched the Solana-native USX stablecoin and associated protocol system.
notes: Base USX remains separate from eUSX and YieldVault positions.

title: Origin Protocol introduces Origin Dollar
description: Origin Protocol introduced OUSD as a rebasing stablecoin designed to earn strategy yield in user wallets.
notes: Later security, restart, and compensation chronology remains a separate review queue.
